name: Isogashii Hito no Tame no Kaeizuka
original_name: 忙しい人のためのかえいづか
source:
The Muenzuka (Mound of the Nameless) where the Higanbana are in full bloom.
In the unfolding Manzai comedy skit of Yamaxanadu Shikieiki and Onozuka Komachi a single tengu dances about.

"I came here today to talk about something."

Something concerning the souls at Muenzuka... uh no... something entirely different (Sorry!)
Whether you ask sooner or later, you'll go to hell anyways, declared Shikieiki.

While Fleeing in a panic, as Aya communicates the gist of the [Event], Shikieiki agrees to it.
She agrees to it before Reimu could ask.

And so the [Event] commences with unprecented smoothness, but will it ...

[Translated from the [url=http://kasugasoft.daiwadaw.jp/isohito/kaei/gaiyou.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
彼岸花盛开的无缘冢。
在山艾努四季映姬与小野冢小町展开的漫才喜剧中，一名天狗翩翩起舞。

“我今天来，是想谈一件事。”

是关于无缘冢亡魂的事……呃，不，是完全不同的事（抱歉！）无论早晚，你反正都会下地狱——映姬如此宣告。

文慌忙逃跑时，一边传达“活动”的梗概，映姬同意了。
在灵梦开口询问前，她就已经同意。

于是“活动”前所未有地顺利开始，但接下来会……

[译自[url=http://kasugasoft.daiwadaw.jp/isohito/kaei/gaiyou.html]官方网站[/url]]
